How to add a watermark to a PDF

Open Watermark, type the words, choose how strong and whether once or repeated, and press Add the watermark.

Watermark →Free. Nothing is uploaded.

How to do it

  1. Open Watermark and add one or more PDFs.
  2. Type the watermark text, such as DRAFT or COPY.
  3. Choose Light, Medium or Strong.
  4. Choose Once, across the middle, or Repeated all over.
  5. Press Add the watermark and save the files.

A watermark on ID copies

When you hand a copy of your Aadhaar, PAN or passport to a bank, landlord or employer, a watermark that says what it is for makes it harder to reuse. Something like FOR HOME LOAN APPLICATION ONLY, repeated all over, is a common habit. Keep it light enough that the details can still be read.

What a watermark does not do

A watermark discourages copying; it does not prevent it, and someone with the right editor could take it off. To stop a file being opened at all, use Add a password. To take a detail out of a document for good, use Remove areas.

Text along the edge instead

For a quieter mark, such as CONFIDENTIAL along the top of every page, use Header and footer. The watermark text takes English letters and numbers for now. Repeated all over is harder to crop out than a single mark across the middle.

Questions people ask

Is a watermark added to my file by this site?

Only the one you type. This site never stamps its own name or logo on anything.

Can I watermark many files at once?

Yes. Add them all and each gets the same watermark.

Will the watermark hide my text?

Light and Medium let the page show through clearly. Strong is for when the mark matters more than easy reading.

Are my files uploaded?

No. The watermark is added in your browser.

Your file stays on your device. Foolscap does the work inside your browser, so nothing is uploaded and there is nothing for anyone to keep. How you can check
